snippet.title: A Quiet Place | A Brilliant Short Atmospheric Sad Experience | PC
snippet.description:
A Quiet Place | A Brilliant Short Atmospheric Sad Experience | PC
#newgame #gameplay #gaming #indiegame #horrorgaming #atmospheric 

Buy Game - https://danka-dobric.itch.io/a-quiet-place

A short, psychological  horror experience where you, player, quickly age to see how's your family doing now.

MORE INFO:
~10 minutes

In game font: "MouseMemoirs"

CONTROLS:
Movement W, A, S, D
Sprint Shift
Crouch Ctrl
Interaction E
NOTE:
Game has a bit of experimentation going on in it and I tried some new stuff, like moving away from retro graphics, experimenting with movement and colors etc. and I sincerely hope that you will like what you see!

If you run into any bugs or issues, feel free to reach out in the comments, my YouTube channel or by e-mail at vukkdobric@gmail.com
